Document with only style tags produces empty output (styles are stripped)

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><style>body { color: red; }</style></head><body><style>.foo { margin: 0; }</style></body></html>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
